attchmntText: Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Outcome of Annual General Meeting held on August 27, 2014.

Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company was held on February 10, 2015. The Board of Directors have taken following decisions :    1. Approved the proposal for migrating the equity shares of the company from NSE SME platform i.e. EMERGE to the Main Board of NSE subject to approval of shareholders through the process of postal ballot / e-voting as per SEBI ICDR Regulations 2009 and other applicable rules/regulations.    2. Board of Directors approved the notice to the shareholders for the purposes of postal ballot and e-voting to seek approval of shareholders for requisite resolution.    3. The Board also finalized and taken on record the list of shareholders as per the latest Benpose available with the company and Registrar for the purposes of dispatch of notice of postal ballot.      4. The voting period shall commence on February 16, 2015 and the completed postal ballot form shall reach the scrutinizer not later than March 17, 2015. The result of postal ballot shall be declared by the company on March 18, 2015.    5. Board also discussed current business activities of the company.

Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the Postal Ballot Notice, pursuant to Section 110 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014.
Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Outcome of the Board Meeting of the Company held on February 2, 2015.
Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting of the Company to held on February 24, 2015.

Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at it meeting held on January 24, 2015:(1) Finalised Cut off date as on January 30, 2015 for the purpose of e-voting in an Extra Ordinary General Meeting. (2) Considered notice of Extra Ordinary General Meeting to be held on February 24, 2015.(3) Board also discussed current business activities of the Company.

Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange that in a meeting of Directors of the Company convened on November 14, 2014 the Board had accepted the resignation of Ms. Divya Singh from the designation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer w.e.f. November 14, 2014. The Board therefore appointed Ms. Chavi Rawat on the designation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Outcome of Board Meeting of the Company held on November 14, 2014.

Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange vide letter dated March 31, 2015 a copy of disclosure under Regulation 30(1) and 30(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
desc: Disc. under Reg.30 of SEBI (SAST) Reg.2011

attchmntText: Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Outcome of Board Meeting of the Company held on March 30, 2015.
Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Result of the Postal Ballot along with Report of Scrutinizer pursuant to clause 35A of the Listing Agreement.
